title: English Practice Quiz 0616
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.
